title: A clearer signal. A new possibility.
description: Artifactory connects sensing research with photonic design tools. Explore ArtiSense, AIFIELD and the evidence behind a company-level investment conversation.
lead: Artifactory explores what light can help us understand — and builds the tools to design what comes next. Two connected projects. One company-level conversation.

sections.title: From a physical question to an engineered answer.
paragraphs: Sensing begins with a difficult question: how can a small optical response become useful information? Photonic engineering asks another: how can we design and test the systems that produce that response?
ArtiSense and AIFIELD approach these questions from different directions. Their connection is a design workflow, not a shortcut around experimental validation.

sections.title: ArtiSense
paragraphs: A proposed miniaturized chemical-sensing system that combines photonics with signal interpretation. The intended direction includes non-invasive measurement and wearable form factors; these remain research ambitions.
The supplied glucose example concerns optical feasibility and chip design. It does not establish measured glucose accuracy or clinical readiness.

sections.title: AIFIELD
paragraphs: Photonic CAD and simulation tooling for exploring geometry, layers and physical behavior. The September 2026 material describes classical simulation work and partially assisted engineering workflows.
Neural optical-field prediction is a separate research direction. Its assumptions and unresolved questions remain visible alongside the engineering tools.

sections.title: Progress deserves a precise description.
paragraphs: A design answers a design question. A simulation tests a model under assumptions. Neither, on its own, demonstrates the behavior of a fabricated sensing device. Our project pages keep these evidence categories separate.
rows: Optical feasibility and photonic chip-design work; physical sensing validation remains to be established.
Design and classical-simulation examples; neural field research retains boundary-condition and generalization limits.

sections.title: Invest in the questions worth answering.
paragraphs: Explore the roles of both projects, what the available work supports, and which milestones would reduce the next uncertainty. The investment discussion is about Artifactory as a company.
For technical partners, the conversation can begin with sensing experiments, fabrication and measurement, or evaluation of the photonic design workflow.
